subject: switch to full accmulating loop
perf_evidence: Commit keeps XXH3 accumulators across a full stripe loop to reduce memory traffic.
change_summary: Rewrites the XXH3 accumulation loop and updates the x86 runtime-dispatch variants.

units.name: raw scalar/SSE2/AVX2/AVX512 accumulation at one, two and four stripes
units.evidence: The 12 fixed-stripe raw targets pass both directions across four x86 modes; a symbolic-stripe AVX2 target also passes with unroll 5.

units.name: public XXH3 fixed 256/320-byte scalar and x86 SIMD paths
units.evidence: Forty source-locked bidirectional Alive2 function-pair checks prove in scalar, SSE2, AVX2, and AVX512 modes.

units.name: x86 dispatch-source per-ISA XXH3 long-input entry points
units.evidence: Four dispatch-source targets pass; AVX512 64-bit times out and AVX2 128-bit forward has no verdict after a module-level SMT memory failure. The latter is inconclusive, not a proof of non-equivalence.

notes: Fixed-length generic public hash targets prove bidirectionally in four x86 modes; changed x86 runtime dispatch and arbitrary lengths remain unresolved.
